create_FlavaModel: create a FlavaModel instance to get image and text embeddings using the Flava multimodal model
run_FlavaModel_get_image_embeddings: run FlavaModel.get_image_embeddings to produce normalized image embeddings from input tensors
run_FlavaModel_get_text_embeddings: run FlavaModel.get_text_embeddings to produce normalized text embeddings from input caption strings
create_XVLMModel: create an XVLMModel instance to get image embeddings using the XVLM vision encoder and projection head
run_XVLMModel_get_image_embeddings: run XVLMModel.get_image_embeddings to produce normalized image embeddings from input tensors
